title: NHK Eテレ — デザインあ (Design Ah!)
description: NHK Eテレ's award-winning Design Ah! programme (デザインあ), aimed at developing design thinking in children. Short segments explore everyday objects — umbrellas, rice bowls, signage — asking 'what is this designed for?' Narration is simple and observational, using core N4 vocabulary about shape, function, and purpose.
creator: NHK Eテレ
